variants.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a full-frame 16:9 landscape visual style audition for the original Chinese zombie survival series set in a warehouse supermarket. Input image 1 is ONLY a composition, wardrobe and story reference. Explicitly REPLACE the cartoon round white head, dot eyes and ink outlines with a believable photorealistic adult Chinese male night-shift stock clerk, approximately 28, ordinary unglamorous face, short dark hair under a teal knitted beanie, tired alert eyes, mustard hoodie under navy sleeveless work vest with blank badge, charcoal work pants, scuffed black work shoes. This is an authorized new realistic-style audition; do not preserve cartoon anatomy. Keep the same premise in every variation: a lone male worker behind a metal shopping cart generously loaded with sealed food, nuts and jerky in the center-left of a long high-bay membership warehouse grocery aisle, tall blue pallet rack uprights and orange crossbeams, stacked bulk cartons and bottled water; eye-level medium-wide 35mm composition, full figure and cart visible, strong aisle perspective, essentially same camera composition as reference. He is sheltering inside, quietly alert rather than smiling or posing for a fashion campaign. No other visible people, no actual zombies inside, no gore, no weapons, no newly invented story events. Keep the scene readable and believable, dark realism through practical light, rich blacks with recoverable shadows and clear subject separation, not crushing everything to black. Photographic skin, natural fabric and metal, restrained detail, no plastic CGI, no anime, no cartoon, no game interface, no oversharpening, no fake HDR, no noisy microtexture, no all-over grunge, no decorative grids, no text, logos, captions, watermarks, borders or panels. Packaging uses subdued abstract labels with no readable writing. One image only, not a collage. Variation A: COLD BLUE CINEMATIC REALISM. A recently closed, still intact warehouse supermarket before the power outage, most overhead fixtures off but a few distant industrial white lights remain on. Desaturated steel-blue ambient light, gentle cold skylight spill, a very restrained warm rim from an unseen security room at the aisle edge, dimensional low-key lighting. Tense, quiet, high-budget live-action survival-thriller still photographed on a large-sensor cinema camera, controlled contrast, soft highlight roll-off, very subtle fine film grain. Shelves and supplies orderly, no destruction. The yellow hoodie is worn but recognizably mustard, the cart is a clear resource-survival visual anchor. Dark blue-gray environment, muted ochre human accent, realistic and clean, not orange-teal commercial grading.
